title: Site Safety Manager
description: Site Safety Manager (HSE) – Power Generation / EPC Location: Kirkuk, Iraq Employment Type: Full-Time | Renewable 12-Month Contract Rotation: 8 Weeks On / 2 Weeks Off (Expatriates) Salary: Negotiable Expected Start: January 2027 About the Company Our client is an international energy and infrastructure company specialising in Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) projects within the power generation sector. The company delivers large-scale energy infrastructure projects, including gas turbine power generation, combined-cycle power plant conversions, turbine inlet air cooling systems and power plant modernisation. Currently undertaking multiple major projects for Iraq's Ministry of Electricity, the company is converting existing simple-cycle power plants into more efficient combined-cycle facilities. With further projects planned, the organisation offers opportunities for experienced professionals to contribute to major infrastructure developments and potentially support future projects. About the Role We are seeking an experienced Site Safety Manager (HSE) to oversee all health, safety and environmental activities on a major combined-cycle power plant conversion project in Kirkuk, Iraq. The successful candidate will lead the site HSE function, manage subcontractor safety compliance and ensure safe construction and commissioning activities within an operational power plant. The position reports to the Project Manager, with a functional reporting line to the Head of HSE in the USA. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement and maintain the Project HSE Management Plan in accordance with ISO 45001, OSHA and Iraqi regulations. Oversee HSE compliance across construction, installation and commissioning activities. Manage safety procedures for brownfield operations, including PTW, SIMOPS, LOTO and plant shutdowns. Supervise high-risk activities including heavy lifting, working at height, confined spaces and electrical works. Lead the site HSE team and monitor subcontractor safety performance. Conduct safety inspections, audits, incident investigations and risk assessments. Prepare HSE performance reports and maintain compliance with project safety requirements. Manage safety training, emergency response procedures and evacuation preparedness. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering or a related field. Recognised HSE certification such as NEBOSH, IOSH or OSHA 30. 10+ years of HSE experience in major industrial or EPC construction projects. Minimum 5 years in an HSE management or leadership position. Strong experience in power generation, CCGT projects or heavy industrial construction preferred. Experience with brownfield construction, operational power plants, PTW, SIMOPS and shutdown safety. Proven experience managing HSE teams and multiple subcontractors. Strong knowledge of international HSE standards and safety management systems. Fluent English; Arabic or Kurdish advantageous. Previous experience in Iraq or the Middle East highly desirable. Employment Package Competitive, negotiable monthly salary. Renewable 12-month contract. 8 weeks on / 2 weeks off rotation for expatriates (paid). Company-provided economy flights, accommodation and meals. Medical, casualty and evacuation insurance. Security arrangements and visa costs covered. Potential opportunities across future power generation projects. Working Schedule: Saturday–Thursday, 10 hours daily for expatriates. Iraqi nationals work 8 hours daily. Apply Now If you are an experienced HSE Manager with a strong background in power generation, EPC construction or combined-cycle power plant projects, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your updated CV highlighting your relevant project experience, HSE leadership background and professional certifications.

title: HSE Supervisor
description: Job Description Job title : HSE Supervisor Location : Basra, Iraq Job reference # : 34113 Contract type : Permanent Language requirements : Fluent in English and Arabic; knowledge of Italian is a plus. At Eni , we are looking for an HSE Supervisor to join Eni Iraq B.V. in Basra , Iraq. You will be responsible for ensuring the effective implementation of the Project Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Management System at site level. Working closely with site management, you will play a key role in promoting a strong safety culture, overseeing daily HSE activities and ensuring compliance with company, client and local regulatory requirements. This is a field-based position requiring a strong on-site presence, proactive safety leadership and the ability to influence safe working behaviours across a multicultural workforce. About Eni Iraq B.V. Eni Iraq B.V. is a leading energy company at the forefront of the exploration, development, and production of hydrocarbons in Iraq. Since 2009, we have been actively involved in the development of the Zubair oil and gas field in the Basra region, which is one of the most significant assets in Eni's global portfolio. This field plays a crucial role in meeting the growing demand for energy and has been a key contributor to both the local economy and the broader energy sector in Iraq. Our commitment to sustainable development extends far beyond energy production. At Eni Iraq, we prioritize creating a positive, lasting impact in the communities where we operate. We invest in local education programs, improve healthcare access, and lead environmental sustainability initiatives to support the long-term development of the Basra region and Iraq as a whole. By joining us, you will be part of a dynamic team that is shaping the future of energy, contributing to innovative solutions, and playing an active role in Iraq's energy sector. Eni Iraq offers you the opportunity to be part of an organization that balances cutting-edge energy development with a strong focus on the well-being of local communities and the environment. Join us and make a real difference, be part of a team that is driving progress, sustainability, and positive change in Iraq and the energy industry worldwide. Main Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate the implementation of HSE plans, procedures and operational performance initiatives across all site activities. Conduct daily site inspections, identify and report unsafe acts and conditions, and ensure appropriate corrective actions are implemented and followed up. Participate in Job Safety Analysis (JSA) and Permit to Work (PTW) reviews before work commences. Monitor compliance with company and client HSE requirements, ensuring appropriate use of PPE and maintaining high housekeeping standards. Lead toolbox talks and safety briefings to promote HSE awareness among employees, contractors and subcontractors. Support investigations into incidents, near misses and unsafe conditions, preparing reports and recommending appropriate preventive measures. Verify the effective implementation of emergency response procedures and drills, taking a leading role in on-site emergency exercises. Coordinate with subcontractors’ HSE representatives to ensure alignment with site safety requirements and standards. Maintain accurate HSE records, including training records, site inspection reports and HSE performance indicators. Support the implementation of environmental controls, including waste segregation, spill prevention and emissions control. Promote continuous improvement and positive HSE behaviours throughout project execution. Encourage and support the use of HSE digital tools to improve site monitoring and reporting. Prepare meeting minutes and HSE reports as required. Promote and communicate the company’s HSE culture effectively to local employees, contractors and subcontractors. Skills And Experience Required Experience working on oil and gas projects. Strong experience in technical safety and HSE management roles. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Science or a related discipline preferred. Fluency in written and spoken English. Good knowledge of international HSE standards, including OSHA, ISO 45001 and ISO 14001. Experience working in multicultural environments and challenging climatic conditions. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and promote safe working behaviours. Proactive and assertive approach, with the ability to take ownership of site HSE activities. Strong reporting and documentation skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office and HSE databases. Collaborative approach, with a commitment to supporting and mentoring junior colleagues. How To Apply Applications are only accepted through our online application system. Please upload your CV in English. About Eni Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000 employees. Originally an oil & gas company, it has evolved into an integrated energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through the decarbonization of its processes and of the products it sells to its customers. In line with this goal, Eni invests in the research and development of technologies that can accelerate the transition to increasingly sustainable energy. Renewable energy sources, bio-refining, carbon capture and storage are only some examples of Eni's areas of activity and research. In addition, the company is exploring game-changing technologies such as fusion energy – a technology based on the physical processes that power stars and that could generate safe, virtually limitless energy with zero emissions. title: Airfield Safety Manager
description: This position is physically located in Balad, Iraq Serves as Airfield Safety Officer for the Airfield and all Air Transport Services. Versatile, self-starting individual that works well on their own, with very little to no supervision, to develop/improve an Army airfield safety program. Work assignment will be managing the various elements of a regional airfield safety program as well as subcontracted aviation COCO and GOCO services and reporting their status to Senior Management Team; must have in-depth knowledge of Federal, Local, and Army methods, practices, principles and procedures to perform effectively; manages resources to promote a wide variety of training activities designed to achieve awareness of airfield safety and corresponding preventive procedures; manages resources to perform on a recurring basis an effective airfield [AAF] and heliport [AHP] management program in accordance with AR-95-2 and standard operating procedures established by the Senior Airfield Authority; to cite legal violations, recommend corrective actions, and insure that hazardous conditions are effectively controlled ensuring required programs are functioning effectively. This position description is subject to change at any time as needed to meet the requirements of the program or company. Establishes a contract-wide [regional] airfield [AAF] and heliport [AHP] management program in accordance with AR-95-2 and standard operating procedures established by the Senior Airfield Authority. To include, but not limited to the following— AAF/AHP pre-accident plan, Wildlife hazard management plan, Flight-line driving training program, Foreign object damage (FOD) prevention program, Risk management and analysis processes, Hazard tracking and log management, and Conducts AAF/AHP inspections and check. Communicates professionally, both orally and in writing, with other senior professionals as needed to relay information necessary for job success. This includes, but is not limited to, staff meetings, performance appraisals, job requirements, metrics, project plans, Quality Standard Procedures, and airfield Best Practices. Communicates with senior management team, area managers and regulators, preparers required corporate reports; ensures airfield data bases are current and accurate to report on the status a complete airfield management Program. Ensures work areas are evaluated for potential airfield safety non-compliance issues. Ensures findings are reported to workplace leaders with recommended abatement actions for identified deficiencies; ensures corrective actions are tracked to completion. Monitors compliance during area evaluations; documents and reports on non-compliant issues and inappropriate behavior traits observed during audits. Ensures resources required to effectively monitor programs to ensure they exceed basic regulatory compliance, identify needed resources (such as personal protective equipment) and budget for resources, identify required training for employees in various operations. Ensure an effective airfield safety [driving/entry] Training program is established. Sets a good example to the workforce by following all airfield safety regulations, policies, procedures and practices; keeps work area/equipment clean and orderly. Performs other duties as assigned. Education/Certifications: One year related experience may be substituted for one year of education, if degree is required. Bachelor’s degree in airfield management or Air Traffic Control or, combination associates degree with four-years of experience. Army CP-12 Certification preferred. Certificate of Management in Aviation Safety or similar preferred Must be Secret Clearance eligible and/or ability to obtain a Secret Clearance Experience: Minimum four years’ experience as Airfield safety manager with two years in a large regional program development role, with experience in managing airfield compliance, familiar with DOD, Army, EPA, and Federal regulations. Military background and training are beneficial. Skills Excellent communication and writing skills are required along with an excellent knowledge of computer operations to include spreadsheet, database, word processing, and presentation applications. Great organizational and management skills and a strong ability to work independently as a member of a robust team. Supervisory Responsibilities Supervise 2 airfield sites and subcontractor activities as well as multiple unmanned helipads. Indoor and/or outdoor environment with very adverse and harsh conditions (i.e., hot, dry, dusty, desert environment with average temperatures of 30 degrees in the winter and 130 degrees in the summer months). Includes some industrial production environment conditions as well. The worker is subject to hazards. Includes a variety of physical conditions, such as proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electrical current, working on scaffolding and high places, exposure to high heat or exposure to chemicals. The worker is subject to noise. There is sufficient noise to cause the worker to shout in order to be heard above ambient noise level. Physical Requirements: Medium work. Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 30 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects. Employee use of personal protective equipment (PPE) is required for some situations. PPE includes, but is not limited to, head, foot, torso, respiratory, vision, and hearing protective devices.
